info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Delete Careers Applications Withdraw-v4-spec
info.description: The Withdraw Career Applications API facilitates the withdrawal of job applications submitted by candidates. This endpoint allows users to remove their applications from consideration, ensuring that they can manage their job search effectively. Typically used by job seekers, this API provides a straightforward method for maintaining application status, thereby enhancing candidate experience. Companies can integrate this functionality into their applicant tracking systems to offer seamless management of applications.

delete.description: This endpoint allows users to withdraw their application from the system. It effectively removes the application and any associated data from consideration.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to withdraw an application, indicating the necessary parameters for the deletion process.

200.description: The application withdrawal request was processed successfully.

DeleteCareersApplicationsWithdrawRequest.description: A request body indicating the operation to withdraw application.

DeleteCareersApplicationsWithdrawRespons.title: Withdraw Application Response

status.description: Indicates whether the withdrawal operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A reference number associated with the withdrawal operation.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the withdrawal operation.

state.description: The current state of the application after the withdrawal operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the withdrawal operation in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the withdrawal operation.

DeleteCareersApplicationsWithdrawRespons.description: Response schema for the withdrawal of an application, indicating the status and relevant information about the operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user or system that initiated the withdrawal operation.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the withdrawal operation was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the withdrawal operation was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Details regarding the creation and processing of the withdrawal operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request.
